title: The Chess of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion
next_chapter_hook: The Observer's voice echoed in Chen Ji's ears: "The Heavenly Eye is also setting up its chessboard. You brothers are both its pieces"—these words struck like thunder, implying that Chen Nian's existence was by no means accidental.

text.content: The void trembled, golden chains suddenly shattering around Chen Ji's body. That cold and ancient voice did not dissipate; instead, it spread like a tide, transforming into a phantom figure suspended above the shattered River of Fate. Chen Ji gasped heavily, the weakness from the frantic drain of his Heavenly Fate Value nearly causing him to stumble, yet his eyes死死盯着来人, his pupils burning with raging fury. Ten thousand years of scheming? A variable? He, atrash杂役 who had scraped by in the sect's cracks for a decade—was he merely a piece on someone else's chessboard from the very beginning?

dialogue.content: "Holder of the Tianji Record, why look at this one with such eyes?" The phantom's voice carried nofluctuation, as if stating an insignificant fact. "You should know, in a chess game, pieces hold no high or low status. What truly determines victory is always the vision of the chess player."

text.content: Chen Ji slowly straightened up, a mocking smile actually curling at the corner of his mouth. He thought of Mo Xiansheng, of the "inheritance" spoken of by the residual soul guardians, of every struggle and calculation at the edge of life and death. So those so-called "fortunes" and "coincidences" were merely a script written long in advance. He clenched his fists, his knuckles turning white from exertion, yet his voice was unexpectedly calm: "Scheming for ten thousand years? The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's reach is indeed far-reaching."

dialogue.content: The phantom slightly nodded, countless star-like runes flowing around its body—that was the unique mark of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion. "Long? Perhaps." He slowly approached, each step landing on Chen Ji's heart and mind. "The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion has waited over ten thousand years for a variable capable of breaking the Heavenly Eye's monopoly. And you are the most suitable candidate—the holder of the Tianji Record Fragment, destined to walk this path."

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst out laughing, the sound echoing through the empty River of Fate, carrying indescribable irony and desolation. He thought of the hunger and cold in his childhood at Chen Family Village, of the ecstatic joy when the Tianqing Sect Elder brought him to the sect, of every time he barely survived at the edge of exhausting his Heavenly Fate Value. From the very beginning, he was merely a carefully fattened sacrifice. The Heavenly Eye wanted his life, the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion wanted to use him as a blade—the powerful ones of this world truly wielded tremendous authority.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the fire of anger in his chest, forcing out a bitter smile. "Since the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion esteems Chen, Chen shall do his utmost." His tone was humble and obedient, yet a subtle cold light flickered in his eyes—well done, Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, well done with your ten-thousand-year scheme. You want to make me a blade? I'll let you taste the滋味 of being cut by it.

text.content: Chen Ji's smile suddenly vanished, replaced by bone-deep coldness. He stared directly at the phantom, his voice like a blade: "Ten-thousand-year scheming? Variable? The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion speaks with tremendous arrogance. If you wish to use my hand against the Heavenly Eye, you must show some sincerity—not just empty talk of 'destiny'."

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's foresight ability to try seeing through the Observer's cards. Take preemptive action in the information war.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes大量 Heavenly Fate Value, physical burden increases

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer, but secretly activated the Tianji Record. A blurred image flashed through his mind—the core深处 of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion actually sealed a being with similar aura to Chen Nian. He suddenly raised his head, his gaze blazing: "What connection does your Heavenly Secrets Pavilion have with my sister?"

dialogue.content: The phantom's steps slightly paused, that ever-unchanging expression actually showing a hint of amusement. "You're quite clever." He stood with hands behind his back, the star runes around him flickering uncertainly. "Indeed, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key is a treasure lost for ten thousand years. The incident at Chen Family Village was merely to return her to her rightful place."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted, a chill rushing from the soles of his feet to his brain. Chen Nian—his sister who had been missing for years and whom he worried about day and night—was she part of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's scheme from the very beginning? Those rumors about Chen Family Village, the Heavenly Eye's pursuit, the Holy Sect's conspiracy... all cluescrazed交织 in his mind, weaving into an unimaginable giant net. He gritted his teeth, nails deeply嵌入掌心, blood dripping unnoticed.

dialogue.content: "Don't be too quick to rage, young man." The Observer's voice remained placid yet carried temptation. "You should thank the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion. Had it not been for our intervention over ten thousand years, Chen Family Village would have been reduced to ashes a millennium ago, and your sister would have long become a sacrifice to the Heavenly Eye. Now, she remains safe and sound in the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's core—as long as you're willing to cooperate..."

text.content: Chen Ji猛地抬头, his eyes blazing with fury almost becoming tangible. He recalled the days when he and Chen Nianreliance为生 as children, that frail figure who stuffed her last piece of dry food to him on a snowy night. The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion claimed "protection" yet separated the siblings for years, letting her suffer endless torment at the Holy Sect—what kind of protection was this? He took a deep breath, his voice low and dangerous: "So, saving me was because they wished to use me. Protecting her was because they wished to use her. The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's compassion is indeed expensive."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion uses Chen Nian as leverage to coerce; Chen Ji must decide how to respond:

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, burying all emotions deep in his heart. After a moment, he raised his head, his expression already restored to its usual timid appearance: "Whatever the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion wishes Chen to do, Chen will comply. Only... please let me see Nian'er." His voice slightly trembled, perfectly displaying a brother's longing for his sister—acting skills truly flawless.

choices.description: Since this is a transaction, the terms must be clear. Chen Ji wants not just to see Chen Nian but to know the complete truth.

text.content: A cold smile curled at Chen Ji's lips, his voice neither humble nor overbearing: "Cooperation is possible, but this Chen Ji never acts in the dark. The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion wants me to oppose the Heavenly Eye, yet you must let me understand the full scope of this chess game. Where is my sister? What is the Heavenly Eye's true purpose? And—" he paused, his gaze like a blade, "by what right does your Heavenly Secrets Pavilion think I will obediently comply?"

dialogue.content: The Observer fell silent for a moment, the runes around him suddenly flickering intensely. "You are indeed more troublesome than this one anticipated." An edge of admiration actually appeared in his tone. "Very well, telling you也无妨. The Heavenly Eye is not as simple as you imagine—it..." The phantom's voice suddenly lowered. "It is also scheming. You brothers have been its pieces from the very beginning."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart was shocked to its core—brothers? He frantically searched his memory about "brothers"—he was an orphan from Chen Family Village, having relied on his sister since childhood, so where did a brother come from? Unless... he recalled the blurred figure occasionally flashing on the Tianji Record Fragment, Mo Xiansheng's欲言又止 expression, the second faint presence always present during each vision. That never-met yet blood-connected existence—who exactly was it?

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Eye has schemed for ten thousand years, its pieces scattered across the three realms." The Observer's voice drifted over. "Do you think the Tianqing Sect's old Patriarch took you as a disciple for no reason? Do you think Mo Xiansheng's residual soul specifically guards the first page of the Tianji Record for no reason? Even, do you think your sister happened to possess that special constitution capable of disrupting foresight? All of it was deliberately arranged by it."

text.content: Chen Ji's breathing suddenly急促起来. Ling Yuan, the Tianqing Sect's old Patriarch—that old fox who ostensibly protected him but secretly harbored malicious intentions, was actually a piece of the Heavenly Eye? Mo Xiansheng had guarded the Tianji Record Fragment for ten thousand years—what truth was he hiding? And Chen Nian's foresight-disrupting constitution was the key that pulled him through countless dangers... was all of this coincidence or predestination? He suddenly felt an unprecedented chill—turns out, what he thought was "meticulous planning" was merely following a predetermined course on someone else's chessboard.

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcibly suppressing the rage and unwillingness churning in his chest. When he opened them again, those eyes had restored their usual calmness and depth. "Very well, the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion wants cooperation; Chen complies." His voice was plain as water, yet his heart was surging with惊涛骇浪—Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, Heavenly Eye, you both wish to make me a chess piece? Then let's see who devours whom in the end.

choices.description: Even if shattered, absolutely refuse to be someone's puppet. Chen Ji will forge his own path.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed uproariously to the sky, the sound凄厉而determined. "What a magnificent ten-thousand-year chess game! What a magnificent Heavenly Eye!" He fiercely wiped the blood from his mouth, his eyes burning with crazy fire. "Even if I, Chen Ji, fall here today, I will never crawl to survive! You wish to play chess? Very well, today I, Chen Ji, shall overturn this chessboard!"

dialogue.content: The Observer's phantom slightly trembled, seemingly moved by Chen Ji's reaction. After a moment, he let out a long sigh: "As the records state, indeed all holders of the Tianji Record are people of integrity who never bend. Very well, this one will give you a promise today—as long as you help the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion break the Heavenly Eye's monopoly, your sister will be safely returned. As for your 'brother'..." he meaningfully glanced at Chen Ji. "There will come a day when battle between you is inevitable."

text.content: Upon hearing the four words "battle is inevitable," Chen Ji's heart was filled withcomplex滋味. He never knew he had a brother, let alone whether that never-met blood relative was friend or foe. But at this moment, he had no choice. The Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's power was深不可测, the Heavenly Eye's conspiracy covered the three realms—if he did not borrow strength, death was the only outcome. He took a deep breath, his voice low and firm: "I need time to prepare. Within three days, I will give the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion an answer."

dialogue.content: The Observer was silent for a moment, the runes around him slowly dissipating. "Three days?" a hint of amusement appeared in his voice. "Very well, three days will be granted. But this one must remind you—the wheel of destiny has begun to turn; the longer you delay, the greater the price you will have to pay. Consider carefully, holder of the Tianji Record." The phantom gradually faded, leaving only final words echoing in the void: "Next time we meet, this one awaits your answer."

text.content: The phantom completely dissipated, and the River of Fate returned to silence. Chen Ji stood alone in the void, surrounded by endless darkness and emptiness. His body was weak from the massive consumption of Heavenly Fate Value, yet what exhausted him more was the heaviness in his heart. A ten-thousand-year chess game, two major forces, a never-met brother, a sister missing
